messages:
maya: quick heads-up — i've dropped a draft PRD for the routing + fallback strategy into the drive. need a short read before tomorrow's product sync. primary asks: tier definitions, region constraints, compat matrix, and launch gating criteria.

alex: looking now. quick q — do we prefer same-region fallbacks to quantized variants, or cross-region fallbacks to full-precision variants when cache warmup matters?

maya: preference is same-region first to preserve latency & data residency. cross-region only for tier-2/3 when latency SLOs can be relaxed. will add that to the criteria.

chris: FYI on acceptance criteria we should have measurable thresholds:
- tier-1: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 450ms under normal load
- quality regression: < 2 pts delta on our eval suite when using fallback
- observability: per-route tracing + token-level cost breakdown available within 5min

sam: customer ask: several enterprise leads require strict region pinning for Dedicated/Private — those must never route cross-region even for fallback. add as a hard constraint.

nina: edge cases to call out in PRD:
- kv-cache incompatibility between quantized and fp16 variants (may break continuation tokens)
- model-ops mismatch when rolling from v1 -> v2 (kv layout changed)
- partial responses if fallback triggers mid-stream

jitendra: proposing a simple compatibility matrix format for the spec (keeps PRD compact):
```
compat_matrix: {
  "gptx-1": ["gptx-1-fp16", "gptx-1-q4_0"],
  "gpt-mini": ["gpt-mini-q4_0"],
  "bloom-3": ["bloom-3-fp16"]
}
# semantics: first entry is canonical; subsequent entries are compatible fallbacks ordered by preference
```

maya: perfect. also adding rollout gating: canary 5% for 6h + quality check run (auto-eval on sampled traffic) before 25% -> 100% rollout. failure policy: immediate rollback + auto-alert.

alex: operational note — implement a fallback score that combines latency penalty + quality delta + data-residency penalty. simplest: score = w1*latency_delta + w2*quality_drop + w3*residency_violation_flag. we can tune weights per-customer tier.

deploy-bot: FYI — test canary config template created: `canary_pct=5 window=6h health_checks=[latency,eval]`.

maya: excellent. action items before product sync:
- alex & jitendra: finalize compat matrix + export script to generate policy JSON
- chris: draft acceptance criteria section with concrete thresholds (use metrics above as a starting point)
- sam: enumerate customer contracts that need region pinning (legal scope)
- nina: list edge-case tests (kv-cache, mid-stream fallback, version mismatch)

maya: will incorporate PRD changes and share updated link in 2h. please flag anything that would block launch from a platform perspective. :thumbsup:
